en-GB.caesar_arcade4_opening_greenfinger_02: I apologise, hairy one, but I cannot let this artefact fall into your hands.
en-GB.caesar_arcade4_opening_greenfinger_04: In all honesty, your pursuit of the artefact perplexes me greatly.

en-GB.caesar_arcade5_elodie_wins_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Run along now, canine. Before I change my mind.
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Why have you come here? Why do you seek the accursed artefact?
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am Elodie, the eternal guardian of this--
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am sorry. For a moment, I thought you were here for the weapon.
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]What? [short_pause]Could it be that... you ARE here for it?!
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_07: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I have been away for so long... Perhaps the world has changed more than I realised...
en-GB.caesar_arcade5_opening_elodie_08: [colour:player_purple][wavy]No matter. I must do my duty no matter who - or what - assails me!
en-GB.caesar_wins_arcade_cutscene_mercia_01: Caesar! [short_pause]What have you been up to?
en-GB.caesar_wins_arcade_cutscene_mercia_02: You've been off having adventures again, haven't you?
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_darkmercia_wins_darkm: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I had hoped for more of a fight...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_greenfinger_wins_gree: I am sorry, Mercia.[short_pause] This was the only way.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_opening_darkmercia_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]So many nations to conquer... My blade craves bloodshed.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_opening_darkmercia_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]What this is, Floran, is an awakening.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_opening_darkmercia_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I spent [slow]so long[slow] playing politics[short_pause], restraining my strength.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade1_opening_greenfinger_0: Queen Mercia? What has happened to you?!
Is this the influence of the 'ancient weapon'?
Your heart has been corrupted by this dark power...
Tell me, does anything of the old Mercia remain?
It seems not. [long_pause]Then there is only one thing to be done...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_darkmercia_wins_darkm: [colour:player_purple][wavy]How does it feel, 'Lord of the Dead'?
[colour:player_purple][wavy]...To find out your life was meaningless...[short_pause] and your death more so?
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_darkmercia_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I thought you might ENJOY my crusade!
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_darkmercia_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]After all[short_pause], I certainly am leaving a lot of corpses in my wake.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_darkmercia_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Perhaps THIS fight will be worth my time.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_valder_02: The power that emanates from you! [short_pause]Do not tell me you found the weapon...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_valder_03: Clearly you have lost your way.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_valder_04: This destruction... This suffering... [short_pause][shaking]I will not allow it.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade2_opening_valder_05: Perhaps this fight will be your last.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]So the forces of Heavensong wish to stop me.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Try your hardest. [short_pause]I could use the challenge.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I have no interest in such things.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I don't wish to rule. I wish to wage war.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Wielding my own might is all that interests me!
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_darkmercia_07: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Who wants a kingdom? [short_pause]Who wants an empire? [short_pause]I don't revel in petty bureaucracy.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_tenri_02: You wish to conquer all, but soon there will be nothing LEFT to rule.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade3_opening_tenri_03: You leave only ruin in your wake. There is no glory in a kingdom of desolation.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_emeric_wins_emeric_01: I'm sorry I couldn't save you, Mercia...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_00: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Emeric! [short_pause]So nice to see you![short_pause] It's been too long.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am Mercia. [long_pause]I can prove it - I remember my past.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]The years I spent training with you...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]The death of my father, which I did not prevent...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]No, Emeric. This is me. I am Mercia.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_07: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I have merely reached my full potential.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_08: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Spare me your lamentations. They bore me.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_darkmercia_09: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Your words won't stop me, and neither will your soldiers.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_emeric_01: Enough! [short_pause]We both know Mercia is gone. Consumed by malice...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_emeric_02: Mercia was so much more than that... So much more than YOU.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_emeric_03: She was kind, she was compassionate, she was selfless...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_emeric_04: In short, [short_pause]she was everything you are not.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade4_opening_emeric_05: Mercival, [short_pause]I'm sorry for what I must do...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_mercia_wins_mercia_02: But... [short_pause]there's so much I can't undo...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_darkmercia_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Have you been lurking in some little crevice of my mind this whole time?
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_darkmercia_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]You're just some little worm of fear and weakness I've not yet managed to crush.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_darkmercia_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]This is why you always fail - you fight for others.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_darkmercia_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]You let their weakness become yours. [short_pause]I am not so encumbered.
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_mercia_02: How dare you use my body like this! You've hurt so many people! You've--
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_mercia_03: I'm going to fight you. [short_pause]I'm going to overcome you...
en-GB.darkmercia_arcade5_opening_mercia_04: And then I'll undo all the destruction you've brought to Aurania.
en-GB.darkmercia_wins_arcade_cutscene_darkmerc: [colour:player_purple][wavy]But there will be other continents to destroy...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_elodie_wins_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Forgive me. There was no other way.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_elodie_wins_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]You need not worry. [short_pause]None shall take it.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_elodie_wins_tenri_02: I... I understand... [short_pause]But with my last breath, I must ask...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_elodie_wins_tenri_03: If Heavensong cannot take this power...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_elodie_wins_tenri_04: Please, do not let it fall into the hands of Felheim...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]The seal has been broken, the weapon I bear, awoken.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I must take it far from here, before anyone comes in search of it...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Who are you? [short_pause]Tell me you have not come here for the weapon?
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am sorry, but I cannot let it fall into the hands of others.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Long ago, I vowed to keep it from the world. This duty is the reason for my continued existence.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_tenri_03: Such an artefact could keep Heavensong safe in perpetuity.
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_opening_tenri_04: Your power will wane with time. If I do not claim the weapon...
en-GB.elodie_arcade1_tenri_wins_tenri_01: I claim this weapon in the name of Heavensong!
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_elodie_wins_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Perhaps now, in your final moments, you truly understand.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_elodie_wins_greenfinger_0: Requiem's power... It is truly devastating...
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_greenfinger_wins_greenfin: What a curious thing, this Requiem. [short_pause]Such a strange power.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]There is no power to be found here.[short_pause] Only despair.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]It is strange... When I was alive, there were no creatures of your kind in Aurania.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]My spirit has lain dormant for an age[short_pause], but my conviction has not eroded with time.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I will not allow you to take Requiem for yourself.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Please, leave me - I shall not instigate a battle if you retreat.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Then I am sorry for what I must do...
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_greenfinger_01: The instrument you carry... I can feel its pull...
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_greenfinger_02: It must be the rumoured 'weapon of power'.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_greenfinger_03: The Floran have been here for quite some time. [short_pause]You must be ancient indeed.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_greenfinger_04: Its name is Requiem? [short_pause]I'm afraid I cannot give up the chance of claiming it.
en-GB.elodie_arcade2_opening_greenfinger_05: I believe it could be a force of good for my people.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_elodie wins_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Your own dark ambition was your undoing.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_elodie wins_valder_01: The weapon's power... [short_pause]It has overcome me...
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]It is, and shall remain, far from your grasp.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Spare me your posturing. I tire of leaders like you.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I have slumbered so long, and yet I awaken to find some things do not change.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_01: Ah, the artefact. It has come to me at last.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_02: [slow]No[slow], I think not. [short_pause]I will claim its power in the name of Felheim.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_03: With the Fell Gauntlet fuelled by Requiem's magic, the dead will rule Aurania.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_04: 'Leaders like me'? [short_pause]I think you'll find there are none.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_05: Perhaps a demonstration of my skills is required.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_opening_valder_06: And once I am finished, [short_pause]I shall claim that weapon of yours.
en-GB.elodie_arcade3_valder_wins_valder_01: Your weapon shall serve me well.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Your intentions were noble, but many have tried to put an end to Requiem...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]My soul is bound to it.[short_pause] But I am not its master, I merely guard its power.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]What are you implying, Queen Mercia of Cherrystone?
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]To try could leave my soul in ruins... but perhaps you are right...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_mercia_01: I... [short_pause]I knew I couldn't stop you[short_pause], but I had to try...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_mercia_02: Please[short_pause], listen for a minute... [short_pause]You and Requiem, you're part of each other, aren't you?
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_mercia_03: It looks like you control it in battle pretty well...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_mercia_04: Maybe your will is enough to overcome Requiem.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_elodie wins_mercia_05: Maybe YOU are the only one who can end it.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_mercia_wins_mercia_02: But with you gone, we have a chance to destroy Requiem once and for all.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Yes. I am Princess Elodie of Cacophony... [short_pause]a nation long deceased.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Are you another would-be despot, wishing to claim Requiem for your own glory?
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]If we had met in another lifetime, perhaps we could have been friends.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I believe you MEAN well. [short_pause]I do not believe you will succeed.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]And I cannot let you try.[short_pause] The risk is too great.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_elodie_07: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I must take the weapon far away from everyone.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_01: Are...[short_pause] Are you the guardian spirit of the 'weapon of power'?
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_02: Its name is Requiem? [long_pause]No[short_pause], I don't want to claim it.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_03: I'm Queen Mercia of the Cherrystone Kingdom...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_04: And I want to DESTROY Requiem.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_05: And I think that together we can do it!
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_06: My Royal Mage, Emeric, thinks there's a way.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_07: You... [short_pause]don't believe me, do you? You don't believe it can be done...
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_08: Then I'm sorry, [short_pause]but I have to try to stop you.
en-GB.elodie_arcade4_opening_mercia_09: You can't run from your problems forever. It's time to confront them.
en-GB.elodie_arcade5_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]This place... [short_pause]I remember it from long ago...
en-GB.elodie_arcade5_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am deep within my own soul.[short_pause] And Requiem is here.
en-GB.elodie_arcade5_opening_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Perhaps the Queen is right. If I can overcome this shadow...
en-GB.elodie_arcade5_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Perhaps then I will be a slave NO LONGER!

en-GB.elodie_wins_arcade_cutscene_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I have been a slave to Requiem for so long...
en-GB.elodie_wins_arcade_cutscene_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I feel a trickle of its power, but none of its malevolence.
en-GB.elodie_wins_arcade_cutscene_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]No. I feel happy. I feel free.
en-GB.elodie_wins_arcade_cutscene_elodie_08: [colour:player_purple][wavy]When Requiem ruled my soul, I could not know contentment. [short_pause]Now it is vanquished, I feel at peace.

en-GB.elodie_wins_arcade_cutscene_elodie_10: [colour:player_purple][wavy]So that is what I will do.

en-GB.tenri_arcade3_tenri_wins_tenri_02: You know nothing of my destiny.

en-GB.tenri_arcade4_opening_valder_04: 'Crave power'? A curious turn of phrase.

en-GB.tenri_arcade4_opening_valder_08: In that way, you and I are not so different.

en-GB.tenri_arcade4_tenri_wins_tenri_02: I must say, Valder[short_pause], that I expected... [long_pause]more.
en-GB.tenri_arcade4_tenri_wins_tenri_04: No, it will be yours.[short_pause] We will meet again soon, Fell Lord.
en-GB.tenri_arcade4_tenri_wins_valder_01: The power you seek will be your downfall.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_elodie_wins_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Trust me, Empress Tenri. This was for the best.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_01: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Why have you come to this place? [short_pause]Do you seek the arcane power of the artefact?
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am Princess Elodie, [short_pause]the guardian of this instrument of death.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_03: [colour:player_purple][wavy]It was created in order to protect my people, but it only brought their ruin.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_04: [colour:player_purple][wavy]Do not inflict this pestilence upon your subjects, Empress. It shall corrupt your heart.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]It shall bring you nothing, for you shall not claim it.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_elodie_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am sorry, but a merciful death in this lonely place is all I can offer you.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_tenri_01: I am Empress Tenri of Heavensong. And... [short_pause]I do.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_tenri_02: I have faced darkness before, and triumphed.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_tenri_03: This weapon will bring me and my people peace and security.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_opening_tenri_04: If this must come to battle, then so be it.
en-GB.tenri_arcade5_tenri_wins_tenri_01: My apologies, Princess. [short_pause]It had to be this way.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_02: [colour:player_purple][wavy]So few of the imperial house endure - your family whittled down to scant remains...
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_05: [colour:player_purple][wavy]You are the only thing that stands between them and a cruel, unfeeling world...
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_06: [colour:player_purple][wavy]One day, there is no telling when, you will be gone.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_07: [colour:player_purple][wavy]And then what becomes of those you hold dear...?
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_08: [colour:player_purple][wavy]The Empire cannot stop the things that wait in the shadows.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_09: [colour:player_purple][wavy]But YOU can protect the ones you love. You are capable, you just lack... [short_pause]resolve.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_10: [colour:player_purple][wavy]With my help... With Requiem's help... You can take that final step.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_11: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am the one who can end the scourge of the undead, and avenge your murdered parents.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_12: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am the one who can ensure the enduring security of your empire, and your only child.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_darktenri_13: [colour:player_purple][wavy]I am what you must become if you are to protect what you hold dearest.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_tenri_01: I claim this weapon in the name of my family.
en-GB.tenri_wins_arcade_cutscene_tenri_03: They will be safe. [short_pause]The might of the Empire--

en-GB.valder_arcade3_opening_tenri_06: They failed to defeat Heavensong, just as you will fail to defeat me now.
